description: Buy one live catalog SKU with prepaid credits. Sends { sku } to POST /v1/purchase and returns that JSON, including the pack or recipe payload. Does not place a reservation. recipe.book-table is documentation the buying agent runs itself. An unknown SKU is rejected. Insufficient balance returns an error and does not deduct credits.

api_key.description: Wallet API key (bsk_…). Optional when the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer. The local stdio process also reads BOTSUPPLY_API_KEY.

sku.description: Live catalog SKU. The field name is sku, not sku_id.

name: purchase
title: Purchase
